Transcript (en): Okay, is it recording now? Say hello to everyone at home! Look at those waves. Who brought the sandwiches? Careful, the sand is really hot. Can we go swimming after lunch? Put some sunscreen on first. Did anyone see where the ball went? It's over by the rocks. This is the best day of the trip. Let's take a photo by the lighthouse. Everyone squeeze in. One more, someone blinked. What time does the last train leave the station? We should check the timetable. I think it's at seven. Then we have an hour left. Let's get ice cream on the way. Chocolate or strawberry? Both, obviously. The sun is starting to set. Look how orange the sky is. Pack up the towels, please. Has anyone seen my sunglasses? They're on your head. Right, let's walk to the station. Wave goodbye to the beach. Bye, beach! That was a lovely day. Same time next year? Stop recording now.
